card.name: Cyber Jar
card.officialText: FLIP: Destroy all monsters on the field, then both players reveal the top 5 cards from their Decks, then Special Summon all revealed Level 4 or lower monsters in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position, also add any remaining cards to their hand. (If either player has less than 5 cards in their Deck, reveal as many as possible.)

design.trigger: A real Flip Summon only; Normal Summon and effect-flip rejected.
design.destroy: Both shared Monster Zones are cleared. Physical monsters move to team GY with UID preserved; tokens disappear and are excluded from physical conservation.
design.reveal: Each active team reveals up to five from the current physical representative Deck. A shorter Deck reveals as many as possible; this is not deck-out.
design.summon: Level 4 or lower Normal/Effect monsters are summoned up to three zones; face-up Attack or face-down Defense is an explicit choice. Fusion, Ritual, higher-Level and excess cards go to hand.
design.ownership: Inactive partner reserves untouched; stolen Cyber Jar resolves for controller; UIDs remain bound to physical owners.
design.replay: activationId persisted in JSON and consumed even when negated.

testCases: destroy face-up/down monsters on both teams
reveal up to five with short Decks
three Monster Zone cap and excess to hand
negation and replay after JSON restoration
3+3 zones, separate Field Zone, Extra Deck 5
hand overflow deferred to End Phase
input immutability and no inventory grant

certification.reason: Isolated adapter only; no central resolver, cardMetadata, cardCertifications, manifest or allowlist changes. M61 handoff pending.

limitations: No engine chain/trigger integration; destruction-triggered effects of other monsters are not dispatched by this isolated adapter.
Position choice is passed as a deterministic map; Discord UI integration awaits M61/command handoff.
Offline TagDuel fixtures only; no live Discord gateway.
